question_text: Construct a UML relationship diagram with Depot, Bicycle, RoadBike and CargoBike. RoadBike and CargoBike specialize Bicycle. Depot holds zero or more Bicycles that exist independently. Omit attributes/methods.
adaptation_rationale: Preserve mixed UML relation distinctions with explicit component lifetimes. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: RoadBike and CargoBike have generalization arrows with hollow triangles pointing to Bicycle. Depot has a hollow aggregation diamond on its end of an association to Bicycle, with 0..*at the bicycle end.

marking_points.criterion: Both subclass links point to Bicycle.
Correct aggregation at Depot and stated multiplicity.
